# Written source residual witnesses

Complete original source and corresponding root MIT license are retained in each
subdirectory. The tests parse source; they never execute shell commands, C++ user
code, Python imports or socket operations. Bash run, C++ study.cpp and Python
query_client.py retain their exact source bytes from the cumulative development
corpus source packet. The public tests require written definitions and direct
ownership only; runtime binding, preprocessing and execution remain unknown.
